name: Sealing Hand
description: Strike with the edge of a hand whose qi is sealed hard so the blow lands as a single point of weight.

name: Hand Brace
description: Brace both hands before the face with the qi sealed between them to take a straight thrust.

name: Seal Pivot
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot with the qi sealed to the sole and finish square to a new line.

name: Hand Hush
description: Lay a hand over the foe's chest and hush the qi beneath it so the breath comes short.

name: Sealed Draw
description: Draw a breath and spread sealed qi outward to feel for hidden weapons and hidden hurts.

name: Sealed Grasp
description: Close a hand round the arm and seal its qi channels so the limb will not lift or strike for a short span.

name: Wound Seal
description: Lay a sealing hand across a deep cut and close it with qi so blood stops and flesh begins to knit in an ally or yourself.

name: Stay Palm
description: Strike the thigh with a palm that leaves a small lock of qi behind to stiffen the muscle.

name: Stay Guard
description: Set the forearms and let a lock of qi stay in each so they do not give under a heavy blow.

name: Lock Slide
description: Slide the lead foot and lock the knee at the end of the stride so the body stops dead.

name: Brace Turn
description: Brace the elbow against the ribs and turn a thrust off it into the open space beside you.

name: Staying Lock
description: Fix a lock of qi on the foe's lead knee so it stays bent and the next step cannot be taken.

name: Locking Thrust
description: Drive two fingers into a joint and leave a lock of qi in it that stiffens the limb at once.

name: Rivet Fist
description: Hammer a short punch whose qi is driven in like a rivet and fixes the blow in the target.

name: Clamp Elbow
description: Bring the elbow down on the foe's forearm and clamp the qi there so the arm cannot rise.

name: Clamp Guard
description: Clamp the forearms hard on the qi before the face so a blow breaks against a single block.

name: Rivet Step
description: Stamp each step down like a rivet so the stance cannot be shoved back and the next step comes fast.

name: Clamp Turn
description: Clamp a punching wrist briefly between the palms and turn it away along the line of the arm.

name: Rivet Draw
description: Rivet the qi down into the legs with a long breath until each step feels fixed and heavy.

name: Rivet Strike
description: Hammer a narrow rivet of qi through the guard into one point of the body.

name: Clamping Band
description: Clamp the foe's arm against his own side with a band of qi and hold it there as long as the breath is held.

name: Poison Clamp
description: Clamp the qi round a poisoned wound to stop the taint spreading and draw it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Palm Cap
description: Cap the palm with a dome of sealed qi and strike the breastbone so the blow shuts the breath.

name: Cap Guard
description: Cap each forearm with a dome of qi so a blow slides off the curve and cannot bite.

name: Cap Step
description: Cap the heel with qi and spring off it so the step covers a long gap without any noise.

name: Palm Slip
description: Slip the open palm along the outside of a strike and cap it so it slides past the ribs.

name: Palm Seal
description: Press the capped palm to the foe's back and close the channel beneath it so the arm on that side fails.

name: Capping Wave
description: Push a flat wave of qi outward that seals the qi of every foe it strikes for a short span.

name: Wedge Fist
description: Drive a narrow fist into the gap between ribs like a wedge and split the foe's wind.

name: Peg Strike
description: Pound a knuckle down on the foe's collarbone like a peg and set the qi of the arm.

name: Wedge Ward
description: Set a wedge of qi at the forward edge of the guard so a blow splits and runs to either side.

name: Peg Step
description: Drive the rear foot down like a peg and swing the front foot round it into a new facing.

name: Wedge Turn
description: Slide a wedge of qi under a punching arm and lift it over the shoulder and away.

name: Peg Reading
description: Press the qi down through the feet like pegs and feel the weight and tread of every foe near you.

name: Driven Wedge
description: Drive a wedge of qi between the foe's guard and body to pin the arm out from the ribs.

name: Peg Seal
description: Pin a peg of sealed qi into the foe's shoulder to stop the arm from rising above the chest.

name: Wound Palm
description: Strike the foe's old hurt with a palm that sets the qi round it so the pain doubles.

name: Scar Fist
description: Punch with a fist hard as scar tissue that stays closed whatever it strikes.

name: Scar Guard
description: Harden the forearms with qi like old scar tissue so a blow finds no soft place to enter.

name: Scar Step
description: Step on the hardened outside of the foot and keep the weight over it so a fall is not possible.

name: Seam Turn
description: Run the forearm along the seam of an attacking arm and push it off its line.

name: Seam Press
description: Press the edges of a wound together with a seam of qi to hold it shut in yourself or an ally.

name: Stitchline Reading
description: Feel along a body with sealed qi for the seams of old wounds and the places that will give way.

name: Stifled Wound
description: Seal the qi round a fresh wound on the foe so it keeps bleeding and will not mend by its own power.

name: Stitch Seal
description: Stitch a deep wound shut with threads of sealed qi in an ally so the bleeding stops and the edges hold.

name: Taint Seal
description: Seal a poisoned limb at the joint to stop the taint reaching the heart and draw it out slowly.

name: Barred Fist
description: Punch straight along the centre line with the other arm barred across the body behind it.

name: Barred Ward
description: Bar both forearms across the chest with the qi sealed between them so a rush stalls against the bar.

name: Barred Step
description: Advance with the forearm held across the front so each step closes the line before the foe can use it.

name: Crossbar Turn
description: Raise the arm like a crossbar and swing it to knock a blow upward and past the head.

name: Barring Hold
description: Bar the foe's advance with a crossbar of qi at chest height so his rush stops against it.

name: Bar Thrust
description: Thrust the barred forearm straight into the stalled foe and send the qi through the guard in a narrow line.
